test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Cutting corners

options.text: Investing in MNCs to get better returns and exchange
Doing something poorly in order to save time or money
Stitching clothes with a unique design
Cutting the edges to make it small and round

solution:
The correct answer is **DOING SOMETHING POORLY IN ORDER TO SAVE TIME OR MONEY.**
